ValidationRule.description: Checks whether Original Invoice Number is blank or not
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $RecordType.DeveloperName != 'CustomerService', NOT( $Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c),NOT(CONTAINS( $Profile.Name , 'Digital Hub' )), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c , 'Invoice Adjustments'), AND(OR(ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Closed'),ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Closure Pending')), OR( PMC_SS_OriginalInvoiceAmount__c = 0, ISBLANK( PMC_SS_OriginalInvoiceAmount__c ))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Original Invoice Amount cannot be blank or 0
